## Files

1. [`23-gam-motivation.Rmd`](23-gam-motivation.Rmd) / [`.R`](23-gam-motivation.R) — LM residuals on `airquality`, the first additive model.
2. [`23-backfitting.Rmd`](23-backfitting.Rmd) / [`.R`](23-backfitting.R) — backfitting by hand with $\beta_0$ and centring; exact agreement with `gam()`.
3. [`23-first-gams.Rmd`](23-first-gams.Rmd) / [`.R`](23-first-gams.R) — reading `summary()` and `plot()`; Gamma GAM; AIC on a common scale; binomial GAM for `Pima`.
